Notes_and_Tips: Avoid skipping meals during your afternoon and evening work schedule.
When sweet cravings occur, eat a fruit first and wait 10 minutes before choosing another snack.
Keep healthy snacks ready to avoid overeating during stress or boredom.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Practice yoga regularly and try to walk for at least 30 minutes daily to increase your activity level.
Drink 2.5–3 litres of water every day and maintain consistent meal timings even on busy workdays.
